title: Add plural resource errors_found_count
description: Add the plural resource used to localize the validation-errors summary (also fixes a latent bug where the old manual check used '> 1' instead of proper plural rules) ("%1$d error found" / "%1$d errors found").
acceptance_criteria: app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml gains a <plurals name="errors_found_count"> with "one" item "%1$d error found" and "other" item "%1$d errors found"
exact_code:
<plurals name="errors_found_count">
        <item quantity="one">%1$d error found</item>
        <item quantity="other">%1$d errors found</item>
    </plurals>
